default.means: A quality gate failed in the active feature scope.
default.run: bash scripts/feature-autofix.sh (or fix the errors shown above)
default.why: Local gates are the same checks CI will run on your pull request.
suggested: fix errors in active feature scope

web-lint.means: TypeScript or ESLint found problems in the web Golden Path.
web-lint.run: npm run lint in examples/web (then npm run format if that script exists)
web-lint.why: Catching type and style errors on the laptop is cheaper than waiting for CI.
suggested: fix TypeScript errors in feature scope
run npm run lint in examples/web
run npm run format in examples/web if format script exists

web-format.means: Web files are not formatted the way CI expects.
web-format.why: One formatter keeps diffs small and reviewable.
suggested: run npm run format in examples/web

web-test.means: A web unit or component test failed.
web-test.why: Tests are the proof the Golden Path still works after your change.

web-build.means: The web app did not produce a production build.
web-build.why: A broken build never reaches users; fix it before the pull request.
suggested: run npm run build in examples/web

python-lint.means: Ruff found lint issues in the Python Golden Path.
python-lint.run: uv run ruff check --fix in examples/python
python-lint.why: Auto-fix what you can locally so CI stays green.
suggested: run uv run ruff check --fix in examples/python

python-format.means: Python files are not formatted the way CI expects.
python-format.run: uv run ruff format in examples/python
python-format.why: One formatter keeps diffs small and reviewable.
suggested: run uv run ruff format in examples/python

python-type.means: A type checker rejected the Python Golden Path.
python-type.why: Types catch whole classes of bugs before runtime.

python-type-mypy.means: mypy rejected the Python Golden Path.
python-type-mypy.why: Types catch whole classes of bugs before runtime.

python-type-pyright.means: pyright rejected the Python Golden Path.
python-type-pyright.why: Types catch whole classes of bugs before runtime.

python-test.means: A pytest failed in the Python Golden Path.
python-test.why: Tests are the proof the Golden Path still works after your change.

file-limits.means: A file is over the token-economy size budget.
file-limits.run: Split oversized static-data or logic files (300 / 150 lines per AGENTS.md)
file-limits.why: Small files keep agents accurate and reviews short.
suggested: split oversized static-data/logic files per AGENTS.md limits

android-test.means: A JUnit test failed in the Android Golden Path.
android-test.why: Tests are the proof the Golden Path still works after your change.

design-cohesion.means: Design tokens or i18n keys are out of sync.
design-cohesion.why: Shared tokens keep Web and Android looking like one product.
suggested: use design tokens and i18n keys

about-feature-gate.means: The About feature slice failed its add/remove check.
about-feature-gate.why: The About slice is the template for the next vertical feature.

rust-fmt.why: One formatter keeps diffs small and reviewable.

rust-clippy.means: Clippy reported warnings treated as errors.
rust-clippy.why: Clippy catches common Rust mistakes before review.

rust-test.why: Tests are the proof the Golden Path still works after your change.

go-vet.means: go vet found a problem in the Go Golden Path.
go-vet.why: vet catches common Go mistakes before review.

go-fmt.why: One formatter keeps diffs small and reviewable.

go-test.why: Tests are the proof the Golden Path still works after your change.

node-lint.means: Lint failed in the Node Golden Path.
node-lint.run: Fix lint in examples/node (then npm run format if that script exists)
node-lint.why: Catching style errors on the laptop is cheaper than waiting for CI.
suggested: run npm run format in examples/node if format script exists

node-format.means: Node files are not formatted the way CI expects.
node-format.why: One formatter keeps diffs small and reviewable.
suggested: run npm run format in examples/node

node-test.why: Tests are the proof the Golden Path still works after your change.

environment.means: A required toolchain is missing from this machine.
environment.run: Install the tool named in the log, then re-run the gate.
environment.why: Gates cannot prove the stack works without its compiler or runtime.
suggested: install the missing toolchain and re-run

verify-env.means: The environment schema or required-tools check failed.
verify-env.why: verify.sh runs this first so later gates are not chasing a missing toolchain.
suggested: install missing tools named in the log

verify-bootstrap.means: A bootstrap artifact or delegated check failed.
verify-bootstrap.why: The template cannot ship if required files or adapters drifted.
suggested: fix MISSING or FAIL lines above

verify-feature-gate.why: verify --full uses the same stack checks CI will run.
suggested: read the What failed block above
